marks.item: the `82` at-risk figures, unrepaired
marks.why: ### **NEW at `b396`, AND IT IS THE ITEM THE CLOSED ONE BECAME.** ### `82` figures across `64` instruments rest on a matcher that requires a backtick, a case, or a leading marker, under a report that states an absence. ### **THIS ACT REPAIRS NONE OF THEM** -- naming a body of work is not doing it -- and `6` were re-run with all `6` CONFIRMED. ### **A CONFIRMATION IS THE WEAKER RESULT** and `76` are untested. ### **OPEN**

marks.item: the self-reading / corpus-reading distinction, unmeasurable at module granularity

marks.item: the five deafnesses of this sweep
